## V.1 — "lime" vs. "calcium"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "lime" / **PNEUMA:** "calcium ite"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "calcium" — avoids English ambiguity of "lime."

## V.7 — "turn aside" vs. "push aside"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "turn aside" / **PNEUMA:** "push... out of the way"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "push aside" — combines formal structure with stronger verb.
